snippet.title: STARDUST FRONTIER - PAX WEST 2025
snippet.description:
Get ready to travel to the Stardust Frontier on August 29th at PAX WEST 2025! Come visit us at Booth 658 for our first public demo of the game! ➤ https://store.steampowered.com/app/3685050/Stardust_Frontier/
“The feeeeel of the game, the responsiveness, feedback both haptic and auditory, was excellent. The music was bangin', and it kept my head up as I navigated microgame to microgame.”
- Seattle Indies Expo
